scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied and numerical matrix checks reproducible; no independent validation or absolute novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous quantum rings, two positive-rate local absorbers, fixed flux and N, asymptotic in time. Zero-flux compatibility condition is anticipated by Agliari et al. 2009; only the all-flux arithmetic comparison and half-flux profiles are assessed as additional. Not a claim about transport time, noise, or additional traps.
title: A half-flux arithmetic switch in two-absorber quantum rings
